An authoritative prohibition or negative; a forbidding; an interdiction.

examples: An outer detector (OD) region will act as both a passive shield for low energy backgrounds and an active veto for cosmic ray muons.

senses.definition: To officially refuse to approve a proposal, law, or decision.

examples.en: The board decided to veto the expansion proposal.
examples.vi: Hội đồng quản trị đã quyết định bác bỏ đề xuất mở rộng.

examples: Mom and Dad vetoed our menu preferences for the holiday meal.
